\begin{chapstatus}{The thread of this chapter}
Without an F extension, fractions are integers with an agreed scale: Verm1 will move its head by fractions of a cell exactly this way. Next: the first part of the project.
\par\medskip\textbf{Exit ticket} (two to four minutes, alone, on paper):
\begin{enumerate}[nosep,leftmargin=2em]
\item Read RV32IMAC letter by letter. A student writes fmul.s in a cartridge for the kit: what happens, and why does Verm1 move with fixed-point numbers?
\item In Q24.8, which real number does the word 0x00000180 represent? How do you add two Q24.8 numbers, and how do you multiply them?
\end{enumerate}
